trickyParts: Anchored comments on a closed issue: the document service refuses every injection on a closed issue (allowInject); docs.WithCommentMarks marks the comment's own mark, snapshot, projection and thread-root read as owner-verified, and a suggestion's mark and every content edit stay refused.

A closed issue's document socket is admitted read-only, so the browser cannot write a comment mark there: the selection bar offers Comment only and the web sends {artifact, quote, occurrence}; quote-anchor.ts counts occurrences as pmdoc FindQuote does (cross-checked against the Go function).
Message delivery keeps its issue-row lock first (lockIssue, same `for no key update`), so the lock order its comments state still holds.
Registry reads are filtered key watches ended at the initial-values marker, never a cache, so an absence is the bucket's.
